mapper.sql:
FROM J_참여자관리_연계 L JOIN J_참여자관리 A ON L.구직번호 = A.구직번호 JOIN J_참여자관리_로그인정보 B ON A.전담자_계정 = B.아이디 WHERE ISNULL(A.모집경로, '') <> '이관' AND ISNULL(A.진행단계, '') <> '이관' AND B.아이디사용여부 = '사용' AND B.지점 <> '테스트' AND B.권한 IN ('상담', '팀장', '파트장', 'PRA', '총괄', '사원') AND L.연계일 >= #{startDate} AND L.연계일 <= #{endDate}
AND A.전담자_계정 = #{scopeAccount}

COUNT(DISTINCT L.구직번호) AS linkageParticipantCount, COUNT(*) AS linkageEventCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN THEN L.구직번호 END) AS terminatedParticipantCount, SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS terminatedEventCount
mapper.select:
SELECT BR.지점 AS branch, ISNULL(S.linkageParticipantCount, 0) AS linkageParticipantCount, ISNULL(S.linkageEventCount, 0) AS linkageEventCount, ISNULL(S.terminatedParticipantCount, 0) AS terminatedParticipantCount, ISNULL(S.terminatedEventCount, 0) AS terminatedEventCount FROM J_참여자관리_지점 BR LEFT JOIN ( SELECT B.지점 AS 지점,
GROUP BY B.지점 ) S ON BR.지점 = S.지점 WHERE BR.사용여부 = '사용' AND BR.지점 <> '테스트' ORDER BY linkageParticipantCount DESC, branch ASC

SELECT B.지점 AS branch, A.전담자_계정 AS counselorAccount, B.이름 AS counselorName,
GROUP BY B.지점, A.전담자_계정, B.이름 ORDER BY linkageParticipantCount DESC, counselorName ASC
